about: P2-S8-T02 (10 'Performance budget', the second CI gate; 08 S8.3; 09 S8.6). The no-JS render gate's map: every route family of scripts/route_groups.json, in its order, with the fallback element a reader without JavaScript gets on that family's pages, by kind and CSS selector. site/tests/nojs.spec.ts renders one page of each family, its first in route order, with JavaScript disabled and fails when the element is missing, empty, of the wrong kind, inside a <noscript> or not visible. Each selector names an element every page of its family carries, an empty term's page included, so which page is rendered does not decide the result. A family with no entry here fails, as does an entry for a route that is no family. An entry names an element and its selector, or a redirect (its pages are a meta refresh, followed without a script to a page held to its own family's element), or pending (the task that routes the family; it fails once the family has a page and still names no element). For a page that ships JavaScript the element is what the server sends in place of what the script adds; for a citable page that ships none (08 S8.1 row 1) there is nothing to fall back from, so the element is the record itself as sent, the part 09 S8.6 requires to be fully readable without JavaScript. Each basis names the page source the element is read from.

kinds.table: a <table> with at least one row that holds a data cell (09 S8.6: every chart as its table, the coverage matrix as its table)
kinds.list: a <ul>, <ol> or <dl> with at least one item that holds text: a record's fields, a page's entries, or a grouped list whose items are its groups (10 V1: the Atlas as its grouped list)
kinds.svg: an inline <svg> with something drawn in it, a chart drawn at build time (08 S8.3). No family is held to one yet: the detail page's trajectory is drawn from claims.json (P3-S10-T03) and its lineage figure from derived/lineage.json, which `bench build` writes and the draft preview this gate reads does not

families.what: the key facts rail: lifecycle, headroom and adoption, the page's first meaning (08 S8.2, 'first meaning requiring no JavaScript at all'; 09 S10, 'on a phone the facts are usually why you arrived')

families.basis: 08 S8.1 row 1; 10 Record pages. The page source, site/src/pages/claims/[id].astro, does not exist yet, so there is no element to read
08 S8.1 row 1; 10 Record pages. The page source, site/src/pages/conditions/[id].astro, does not exist yet, so there is no element to read

families.what: the version's record: kind, release, items, what changed and whether it broke comparability
the organisation's record: roles, parent, homepage and identifiers
the system's record: maker, type, availability and what it disclosed
the metric's record: range, direction, chance and ceiling, aggregation
the term's inclusion and exclusion tests, as a curator applies them
every neighbouring term's single-facet page, linked and counted, on every page of the family, an empty term's included
families.basis: site/src/views/BrowsePage.astro; 10 V11 'Without JavaScript'; 08 S8.3, the single-facet static route set

families.what: the document's own lists, which each of the three documents has (two of them have tables too)
families.basis: site/src/pages/docs/[...slug].astro; 10 '/methodology/, /trust/' row: static prose and tables

families.what: a meta refresh, no script, to the methodology document
the export surface: each artifact, where it is and its stability contract
the namespace's terms, read from its committed context
the four entry points, each a link to its route or said to be not built
the facet rail as the server renders it, a grouped list in which every term links its single-facet page; combining terms is what JavaScript adds
the directory under the search box, a grouped list of every single-facet browse page and term definition: search degrades to links into the browse-by-facet pages (09 S8.6)
every release event, in the HTML; the filter form only hides items
every published entry with its freshness badge, in the default sort
one row per source: its licence, attribution, last successful fetch and status

the directory in the filter pane as the server renders it: every domain family in the taxonomy's order, counted, an empty one included, with every benchmark under its family linked to its page. The basket lives in the address and is read by JavaScript, which the basket pane says as sent; the static suite report of a ?b= link is P6-S4-T07's
the family index, the server-rendered grouped list inside the canvas container: every benchmark the map places, under its family and group, linked and counted
